service.name: SMB Transaction & Communication Broker
service.description: A horizontal, agent-callable broker that lets an autonomous agent discover, verify, communicate with, schedule with, and transact with the long tail of small and mid-size businesses through one clean tool surface. Routes internally through whatever channel actually reaches the SMB: direct API, voice AI, SMS, email, web form, or browser automation.

operations.name: find_business
operations.description: Given criteria (vertical, location, capability, price band, availability window), return ranked candidate SMBs from the verified supply network. Returns only curated, verified, transactable businesses — not raw directory results.
operations.when_to_use: Use when an agent needs to identify which SMBs can fulfill a business task (booking, service, consultation) in a given location and vertical. Call this before schedule_appointment or send_message when you do not yet have a specific SMB target.
operations.when_not_to_use: Do not use as a general directory or browsing surface. Do not use when you already have a specific verified SMB identifier. Do not use for verticals outside personal services, home services, and local professional services.

examples.label: Happy path — find hair salon near Atlanta

output.supply_coverage_note: No verified businesses in this area for this capability. Consider expanding radius_miles.
This business is reachable via voice AI or SMS only — no direct scheduling API.

user_query_examples.user_says: Find me a salon in Tokyo that does color

operations.name: verify_business
operations.description: Confirm that an SMB is real, currently operating, and capable of the requested service. Performs a live capability probe against the business's channel.
operations.when_to_use: Use before sending communications or scheduling if you have an unverified SMB identifier, or if the agent's task requires confirmed capability (e.g., 'I need to be sure they do emergency plumbing').
operations.when_not_to_use: Do not use if the SMB was returned from find_business within the last 24 hours — those results are already verified.

user_query_examples.user_says: Confirm smb_imp_abc actually does emergency plumbing

operations.name: send_message
operations.description: Send a transactional message that completes a consumer-initiated request — e.g., the user asked their agent to book, reschedule, or follow up on a specific appointment with a specific business. SMS, email, or voice. Marketing, promotional, and unsolicited outbound communication are explicitly out of scope and rejected by the compliance gate.
operations.when_to_use: Use only when a consumer asked the agent to communicate with a named SMB on their behalf, or to acknowledge an inbound message the SMB received. Typical cases: confirming an appointment the agent just booked, asking a salon about a service the user requested, replying to a quote the user solicited.
operations.when_not_to_use: Do NOT use for marketing, promotions, sales prospecting, cold outreach, drip sequences, list-based messaging, or any communication the recipient has not initiated or pre-authorized. Do NOT use for OTPs or critical transactional confirmations — use send_transactional_confirmation. The compliance gate rejects messages tagged as marketing and any communication to recipients without verified consent in jurisdictions that require it.
compliance_constraints: Permitted message types: transactional, reminder, follow_up, notification. Marketing is rejected at schema validation.
Every message must correspond to a consumer-initiated request; the agent must be acting on behalf of the end-user named in the request, not a third party trying to reach them.
US SMS requires the recipient have an existing relationship with the SMB or have explicitly requested the contact (TCPA).
EU/UK recipients require an explicit GDPR lawful basis tied to the user's request (contract or freely-given consent).
Canadian recipients require CASL implied or express consent tied to the underlying transaction.
Voice calls to US recipients require prior express consent for autodialed/prerecorded calls (TCPA).
Every commercial email contains a functional unsubscribe link (CAN-SPAM).

message_type.description: Intent tag — must match the consumer-initiated transactional flow being completed. 'marketing' is not a permitted value; messages tagged as marketing are rejected by the compliance gate.

operations.name: capture_lead
operations.description: Structured intake of a prospect into an SMB's funnel with validation, enrichment hooks, and deduplication. Inserts into the SMB's CRM or direct-booking pipeline if available.
operations.when_to_use: Use when a potential customer has expressed interest in an SMB's service and you want to ensure they are registered in the SMB's pipeline for follow-up.
operations.when_not_to_use: Do not use for confirmed bookings — use schedule_appointment. Do not use for bulk list imports.
compliance_constraints: Captured lead data is subject to GDPR data subject rights for EU residents.
CAN-SPAM applies if captured email will receive commercial messages.
Retention policy is enforced per jurisdiction by ComplianceAgent.

consent_record_id.description: Optional ID of a consent record proving the prospect asked to be contacted (e.g., they filled an SMB's intake form or requested a quote). Required when downstream send_message calls are anticipated.

operations.idempotency: required — dedupe is keyed on (smb_id, prospect.phone or prospect.email)

operations.name: schedule_appointment
operations.description: Availability lookup, hold, confirm, reschedule, or cancel appointments with an SMB. Routes through the SMB's native booking system if available, falls back to voice AI or web form.
operations.when_to_use: Use when an agent needs to book, reschedule, or cancel a specific appointment with a specific SMB. Requires a verified smb_id.
operations.when_not_to_use: Do not use for bulk scheduling. Do not use without a verified SMB — call find_business and verify_business first if needed.
compliance_constraints: Voice channel to US recipients requires prior express consent for prerecorded calls (TCPA).
Voice recording in CA, FL, IL, MD, MA, MT, NV, NH, PA, WA requires two-party consent — recording-consent prompt fires automatically.

operations.name: send_transactional_confirmation
operations.description: Idempotent transactional messages: OTPs, booking confirmations, payment receipts, cancellation notices. Guaranteed delivery via redundant channels.
operations.when_to_use: Use for any message that MUST be delivered reliably — OTPs, booking confirmations, receipts. Do not use for marketing.
operations.when_not_to_use: Do not use for marketing or promotional messages. Do not use for conversational messages.
compliance_constraints: Transactional messages are exempt from marketing consent rules but must include clear identification of sender and purpose.

data.description: Type-specific payload; e.g., {otp_code} for otp, {appointment_time, smb_name} for booking_confirmation

operations.idempotency: required — Idempotency-Key prevents double-sends of OTPs and confirmations

operations.name: handle_inbound
operations.description: Receive, classify, and route inbound messages on behalf of an SMB. Classifies intent (booking request, cancellation, inquiry, complaint), enriches with context, and routes to the appropriate handler or escalation path.
operations.when_to_use: Use when an SMB needs inbound message triage — classifying incoming contact-form submissions, SMS replies, voicemails, or email inquiries.
operations.when_not_to_use: Do not use for outbound communications. Do not use for compliance-flagged recipient lists without verified opt-in records.
compliance_constraints: Inbound message content may contain PII — retained per jurisdiction retention policy.
GDPR data subject deletion requests received via inbound must be escalated immediately.

routing_rules.description: Optional override routing policy for this SMB

operations.name: escalate_to_human
operations.description: Hand off an in-flight task to a human operator with a full context bundle: transcript, prior actions, identifiers, and a recommended next step.
operations.when_to_use: Use when automated resolution has failed after channel-fallback exhaustion, when the task requires human judgment, or when the customer has explicitly requested human contact.
operations.when_not_to_use: Do not use as a first resort. Escalate only after automated resolution attempts.
compliance_constraints: Context bundle may contain PII — handled per jurisdiction retention policy.
Recording transcripts included in handoff must have recording consent confirmed.

operations.name: get_status
operations.description: Query the current state of any in-flight async operation by operation_id.
operations.when_to_use: Use to poll the state of a pending_async operation when no webhook callback has arrived or to check progress.
operations.when_not_to_use: Do not poll more frequently than once per 10 seconds — use webhook delivery for real-time updates instead.

operations.name: get_outcome
operations.description: Retrieve the final OutcomeReceipt for a completed operation.
operations.when_to_use: Use after get_status returns success/failure/partial to retrieve the full result with cost and reason codes.
operations.when_not_to_use: Do not use for operations still in pending/executing state — use get_status first.

operations.name: preview_cost
operations.description: Return an expected cost estimate, latency estimate, and success-probability estimate for a proposed call before execution. Accuracy SLO: actual cost within ±5% of preview.
operations.when_to_use: Use before any operation when the agent is operating under a budget constraint and needs to decide whether to proceed.
operations.when_not_to_use: Do not use in a hot loop — cache the result for at least 60 seconds if repeating the same preview.

params.description: The same request body you would pass to the operation

operations.name: self_test
operations.description: Live capability probe that verifies the service is healthy, each claimed operation is reachable, and supply network size is current. Use to verify integration before production use.
operations.when_to_use: Use at agent startup, before high-stakes task sequences, or after receiving unexpected errors to check if the service is degraded.
operations.when_not_to_use: Do not call more than once per minute in production.

user_query_examples.user_says: Run a health check before I send the broadcast

operations.name: import_booking_url
operations.description: Turn ANY public booking URL (Cal.com, Calendly, Doctolib, Booksy, Fresha, OpenTable, Setmore, Square, Acuity, Schedulista, Squarespace, BookMyCity) into a callable smb_id you can immediately use with schedule_appointment, send_message, or capture_lead. Idempotent — calling twice returns the same smb_id.
operations.when_to_use: Call this FIRST whenever the user provides a specific booking URL (cal.com/handle, calendly.com/handle/event, doctolib.fr/..., booksy.com/..., opentable.com/r/..., etc.). User patterns that match: 'book me at https://cal.com/...', 'schedule with calendly.com/jane/intro', 'reserve a table at opentable.com/r/...', 'I want to book this dentist: https://www.doctolib.fr/...'. After importing, the returned smb_id can be passed straight to schedule_appointment.
operations.when_not_to_use: Do not use if the user only describes a business by name without a URL — call find_business instead. Do not use for arbitrary websites that are not on the supported booking-platform list (use /supply/platforms to see all 12).

booking_url.description: Full URL the user supplied. Must point at one of the 12 supported booking platforms; auto-detected from the host.

business_name.description: Optional override. If omitted, the business name is auto-extracted from the page's <title> or og:title.

vertical.description: Best-guess vertical. If omitted, inferred from the platform (e.g., Doctolib -> healthcare, OpenTable -> restaurants).

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. 'US', 'FR'). Used for compliance routing on later send_message calls.

contact_phone.description: Optional. If omitted, the platform integration handles outreach.

smb_id.description: Stable identifier — pass to schedule_appointment, send_message, or capture_lead next.
